text:
Maria: Heads-up: I put a first-pass PRD + RFC stub for the low-precision / kernel-selection initiative. Need quick alignment on launch acceptance criteria, rollout strategy, and gating rules before I open for full review.

Alex: Quick clarifying Q — are we doing hosted-only beta or including Dedicated? That changes which SLOs we can promise and what we communicate to customers.

Maria: Hosted opt-in beta first. Dedicated follow-up (config-only at GA). Private deployments get the flags but we won’t ship changes by default.

Jules: From QA: we need automated regression checks across our eval suites. Proposal: run 5 seeds per test, check distributional shifts (KS test) + mean metric delta. Also add a 50-sample human spot-check for canary.

Max: Implementation notes: suggest a KernelSelector config object per model with fields: weights, priority_conditions, and fallback_policy. Must support hot reload and per-region overrides. We can implement percent-based canaries via weight adjustments.

Sam: SRE needs concrete observability + abort rules. Ask: add GPU memory tail monitoring, cold-start p95 window, and error-rate alarms. If 99p latency or tail mem exceed threshold during canary, auto-revert to baseline.

Lina: KV cache interactions: low-precision kernels may not be compatible with KV-encoded caches. We should default to "cache-bypass -> baseline kernel" for requests with >1k tokens in KV or when cache hit metadata mismatches.

Maria: Draft acceptance criteria (beta hosted):

```
- Performance: p99 latency <= 220ms for seq <= 128 on p4d-8x under baseline traffic profile
- Quality: mean task metric >= baseline - 1.25% OR semantic-similarity >= baseline - 1.5% (multi-seed averaged)
- Cost: amortized token cost <= baseline * 0.88 (target 0.75)
- Reliability: end-to-end error_rate <= 0.7%; fallback_rate <= 1.5% across routes
- Rollout: canary ramp 2% -> 10% -> 30% -> 100%; minimum 12h soak at each step unless auto-promotion criteria met
- Observability: traces must include model_id, model_variant, route, token_counts, and kernel_selector_decision
- Edge behavior: requests with context_length > 2048 or KV mismatch -> force baseline kernel
- Rollback: automatic abort if quality drop > 1.8% or error_rate increases > 2.5x from baseline
```

Alex: Commercial note: we can’t change billing terms mid-cycle. Recommend labeling this as an "opt-in economy kernel" with projected cost delta shown in the UI (range estimate) and a checkbox for customers. Legal will need review copy.

Jules: Also test streaming mode thoroughly. Some kernels change token-at-a-time latency patterns. Add streaming p95 check and end-to-end partial response checks.

Max: For rollout automation I’ll add a state machine that adjusts weights and evaluates metrics windows. Need a feature-flag gate to enable dry-run toggles per-region. Suggest we reuse existing canary infra.

Sam: Suggested SRE thresholds: cold-start p95 <= baseline_p95 + 120ms; tail GPU mem spike <= 6% above baseline; p99 latency breach triggers immediate rollback. Also require request-level model_variant tagging for tracing.

Lina: Ops edge-case: cross-model routing. If a route pins model version we must respect that; selector should never override explicit model pins. Add a config priority: explicit pin > customer opt-in > autoscale routing.

Maria: Ownership & short to-dos:
- Alex: draft the customer-facing opt-in copy and update billing language (due Thu)
- Max: RFC rollout automation section + selector schema (due Wed)
- Jules: extend eval harness for multi-seed + streaming + KS tests (due Fri)
- Sam: alert thresholds, dashboards, and trace tag requirements (due Wed)
- Lina: KV-cache compatibility matrix + default fallback behavior (due Thu)

Max: I'll open an infra PR for the selector schema and a small simulator to validate weight ramps and safety checks.

Jules: I'll add test cases for sampling variance and a small human review process for first canary.

Maria: Plan: I’ll push PRD + RFC stub today, tag the owners above, and aim for engineering review by EOW. If nobody objects to the ACs here, I’ll fold these into the RFC.

deploy-bot: RFC + PRD branch created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rfcs/tree/kernel-selector-low-precision-1867890123

Alex: LGTM :thumbsup:

Maria: Thanks all — will ping again once PRD is in the repo. Keep comments short in this thread; deep discussion -> RFC thread. :white_check_mark:
